product_overview: Aconvi is a community and property management platform for neighbors, administrators, and service providers. It supports incident tracking, work-order handling, service ratings, and community notices/voting in a unified experience.
core_goals: Create and track community incidents from initial report through final closure
Let service providers accept assigned work orders within the allowed time and progress incidents through resolution
Allow neighbors to rate completed service work with stars and comments
Enable administrators to review incident details and community updates
Support community communication through notices and voting

features.name: Incidence Management
features.description: Users can create incidents, review their status, and follow the progress of each case through the community workflow.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Sign in with administrator or neighbor credentials -> Open the incidents area -> Review the incident list -> Open an incident detail -> See its current status and timeline

Navigate to /login -> Sign in with administrator credentials -> Open the incidents area -> Review incidents filtered by role and status -> Open a resolved incident -> See the closing photo rendered in the incident detail

features.name: Incident Timeline and Activity History
features.description: Users can open an incident detail and observe its activity history as it updates automatically in real time.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Sign in with authorized credentials -> Open the incidents area -> Open an incident detail -> Observe the activity history and timeline -> See the history refresh automatically without reloading the screen

Navigate to /login -> Sign in with authorized credentials -> Open the incidents area -> Open an incident detail -> Wait briefly while the page stays open -> Observe new activity entries appear in the history

features.name: Work Order Assignment Expiration
features.description: Service providers can review an assigned work order within a limited acceptance window before it expires and becomes unavailable.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Sign in as a service provider -> Open the incidents area -> Open an assigned work order -> Observe the two-hour acceptance timer -> Accept the assignment before it expires

Navigate to /login -> Sign in as a service provider -> Open the incidents area -> Open an assigned work order after the acceptance window has elapsed -> Observe that acceptance is disabled and the assignment is no longer available

features.name: Incident Status Progression
features.description: Users can move incidents through the expected service workflow as work progresses from assignment to resolution.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Sign in with authorized credentials -> Open the incidents area -> Open an assigned incident -> Accept the work order -> See the incident move to the scheduled state
Navigate to /login -> Sign in with authorized credentials -> Open the incidents area -> Open an active incident -> Confirm arrival on site -> See the incident move to the in-progress state

Navigate to /login -> Sign in with authorized credentials -> Open the incidents area -> Open an in-progress incident -> Finish the work with closing details and photos -> See the incident move to the resolved state

features.name: Service Rating and Feedback
features.description: Neighbors can submit a star rating and written comment for completed service work.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Sign in as a neighbor -> Open a resolved or closed incident -> Open the rating flow -> Select one to five stars -> Write a comment -> Submit the rating -> See the rating recorded in the incident history

Navigate to /login -> Sign in as a neighbor -> Open a completed incident -> Open the rating flow -> Choose a star value and enter feedback -> Submit the rating -> Return to the incident detail with the new feedback visible

features.name: Community Notices
features.description: Administrators can publish notices and community communications for residents to read.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Sign in as an administrator -> Open the notices area -> Create and publish a community notice -> See the notice appear in the notices list

features.name: Community Voting
features.description: Administrators and authorized users can manage voting activities and community meetings from the voting area.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Sign in with authorized credentials -> Open the voting area -> Review available voting items and meeting entries -> Open a voting item -> See its details and current participation information

routes.description: Panel de gestión de incidencias para administradores
Publicación de avisos y comunicados comunitarios
Gestión de votaciones y juntas comunitarias

features.name: Historial en Tiempo Real
features.description: Refresco automático e inmediato del historial de la incidencia sin recargar la pantalla
user_interactions: Observar la lista de actividades e historial

features.name: Eliminación de Estados Duplicados
features.description: Prevención de entradas consecutivas con el mismo estado en la línea de tiempo
user_interactions: Aceptar orden de trabajo o cambiar estado
Consultar historial de actividad sin duplicados

features.name: Expiración de Orden de Trabajo (OT)
features.description: Deshabilitación del botón de aceptar tras 2 horas de inactividad del proveedor y retorno a estado RECIBIDA
user_interactions: Visualizar temporizador de 2 horas en pantalla del proveedor
Verificar banner de expiración y botón deshabilitado cuando expira

features.name: Valoración del Servicio
features.description: Calificación de 1 a 5 estrellas con comentarios registrada como evento en la incidencia
user_interactions: Tocar botón de valorar el servicio

features.name: Visualización de Fotografía Final
features.description: Muestra la foto de cierre como imagen renderizada en el panel web y no como ruta de texto
user_interactions: Abrir incidencia resuelta en panel del Administrador
Ver fotografía de cierre en cuadro de imagen
